title.en: An Act to Amend Subsection (N) of Section Twenty-Four Hundred and Forty-Four of Act Numbered Twenty-Seven Hundred and Eleven, Known as the Administrative Code, as Amended By Act Numbered Twenty-Seven Hundred and Seventy-Four, Empowering the Municipal Board of the City of Manila to Establish a Tax on Automobiles.

text.en:
Subsection (n) of section twenty-four hundred and forty-four of Act Numbered Twenty-seven
hundred and eleven, known as the Administrative Code, as amended by section eight of Act Numbered
Twenty-seven hundred and seventy-four, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(n) To tax motor and other vehicles, notwithstanding the provisions to the contrary contained in section
thirteen of Act Numbered Twenty-five hundred and eighty-seven, and draft animals not paying any Insular
tax: Provided, That all automobiles and trucks belonging to the Insular Government or to any provincial or
municipal government and automobiles and trucks not regularly kept in the city of Manila shall be exempt
from such tax."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 28, 1921.
